name: Milk Rhythm
blurb: Tap to the beat as notes fall into the pails.
howTo: Tap a lane when a note reaches the pail line. Keep a streak going!

name: Egg Catch
blurb: Catch falling eggs in your basket. Dodge boots!
howTo: Drag the basket left and right. Golden eggs are worth extra. Boots and feathers break your streak.

name: Weed Pull
blurb: Pull weeds before they spread. Don't tap the crops. Definitely don't tap Luna.
howTo: Tap or swipe weeds to pull them. Leave the crops alone, and let Luna walk by in peace.
